originIdentities.statement: Explicit product-state station selection for the first corridor: the exact ODPT station odpt.Station:TokyoMetro.Ginza.Asakusa in the C4F dataset. Tokyo Metro's operator page identifies Asakusa Station/G19/G18; the C4F ODPT record supplies the exact G-19 station code on the exact Ginza railway. This is an explicit identity contract, not display-name, coordinate, nearest-station, or fuzzy matching.
